plan.subject: LLM agents

queries.query: ("LLM agent" OR "language model agent" OR "large language model agent" OR "autonomous LLM agent") AND (agent OR orchestration OR planning OR execution)
queries.rationale: Catches papers that explicitly identify as LLM-agent work, including broad architectural and systems contributions.

queries.query: ("agent workflow" OR "agentic workflow" OR "multi-step agent" OR "agent pipeline") AND ("large language model" OR LLM OR "language model")
queries.rationale: Targets practical workflow and pipeline designs for building agents beyond single-turn prompting.

queries.query: ("multi-agent system" OR "multi-agent collaboration" OR "multi-agent debate" OR "society of mind") AND ("large language model" OR LLM OR "language model")
queries.rationale: Finds work on coordinating multiple LLM-based agents, including collaboration and debate-style setups.

queries.query: ("task decomposition" OR "hierarchical planning" OR "subgoal planning" OR "plan-and-execute") AND ("LLM agent" OR "language model agent" OR "large language model")
queries.rationale: Focuses on how agents break down goals and structure multi-step execution.

queries.query: ("tool use" OR "tool calling" OR "function calling" OR "API calling") AND ("LLM agent" OR "language model agent" OR "large language model")
queries.rationale: Covers one of the most practically important agent capabilities: invoking external tools and APIs.

queries.query: ("retrieval-augmented generation" OR RAG OR "knowledge retrieval" OR "memory retrieval") AND ("LLM agent" OR "language model agent" OR "large language model")
queries.rationale: Captures agent designs that augment reasoning and action with retrieval or external knowledge access.

queries.query: ("agent memory" OR "long-term memory" OR "episodic memory" OR "memory-augmented agent") AND ("LLM agent" OR "language model agent" OR "large language model")
queries.rationale: Finds work on persistent state, memory architectures, and context management for agents.

queries.query: ("reflection" OR Reflexion OR "self-reflection" OR "self-improvement") AND ("LLM agent" OR "language model agent" OR "large language model")
queries.rationale: Targets iterative self-critique and refinement methods that often improve agent reliability in practice.

queries.query: ("reasoning and acting" OR ReAct OR "action reasoning" OR "interleaved reasoning") AND ("LLM agent" OR "language model agent" OR "large language model")
queries.rationale: Catches agent paradigms that tightly couple deliberation with environment interaction.

queries.query: ("web agent" OR "browser agent" OR "computer use" OR "GUI agent") AND ("large language model" OR LLM OR "language model")
queries.rationale: Targets embodied software agents that operate browsers, desktops, or interfaces, a high-practicality area for engineers.

queries.query: ("code agent" OR "software engineering agent" OR "repository-level agent" OR "coding agent") AND ("large language model" OR LLM OR "language model")
queries.rationale: Surfaces agent work most directly relevant to a software engineer, especially around coding and repository tasks.

queries.query: ("benchmark" OR evaluation OR "agent benchmark" OR AgentBench OR SWE-bench) AND ("LLM agent" OR "language model agent" OR "large language model")
queries.rationale: Finds papers defining or using practical agent evaluations, useful for judging what techniques actually matter.

queries.query: ("hallucination" OR reliability OR robustness OR safety) AND ("LLM agent" OR "language model agent" OR "autonomous agent")
queries.rationale: Covers the limitations engineers care about when agents are deployed in real workflows.

queries.query: ("self-correction" OR "error recovery" OR "verification" OR "critic model") AND ("LLM agent" OR "language model agent" OR "large language model")
queries.rationale: Targets techniques for catching and repairing agent mistakes during execution.

queries.query: ("environment feedback" OR "interactive environment" OR "closed-loop interaction" OR "agent-environment interaction") AND ("large language model" OR LLM OR "language model")
queries.rationale: Captures agents that adapt through iterative feedback from tools, simulators, or external environments.

plan.coverage_notes: This plan covers core agent architectures plus the practical engineering axes most likely to change how agents are built: planning, tool use, retrieval, memory, reflection, evaluation, reliability, and software-facing applications. It intentionally avoids generic LLM-only topics like prompting or fine-tuning unless they are framed through agents, and it skips vendor/tool-name queries to preserve precision. The profile assumption is that this reader wants implementation-relevant research breadth more than deep specialization in a single benchmark or subdomain.
